build.//: development is the one to build first. It produces a dev client — the app shell with your native modules compiled in — which is what makes push, deep links and haptics testable at all. Expo Go cannot do those.

preview.//: A release build you can hand to someone. APK rather than AAB so it installs by sideload without going through Play.

production.//: Store submission. Android emits an AAB, which is what Play requires.
